summary: Enable optional GLM TP3 FP8 heads for unquantized ModelOpt shards
compatibility: The opt-in FP8 decode path accepts both unquantized head method classes while preserving BF16 shape checks and explicit runtime head quantization.
details: ModelOpt mixed-precision checkpoints assign an unquantized linear method to a BF16 LM head that is absent from the quantized-layer manifest.
The FP8 wrapper preserves the original method for weight processing and BF16 fallback. Runtime MXFP8 and NVFP4 heads remain excluded.
